versos.grego: Ἤκουσαν δὲ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ οἱ ὄντες κατὰ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ὅτι καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
controles.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
controles.livre: E os apóstolos, e os irmãos que estavam na Judeia, ouviram que também os gentios receberam a palavra de Deus.

versos.grego: Ὅτε δὲ ἀνέβη Πέτρος εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, διεκρίνοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς

controles.web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
controles.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
controles.livre: E quando Pedro subiu a Jerusalém, discutiam contra ele os que eram da circuncisão;

versos.grego: λέγοντες ὅτι Εἰσῆλθες πρὸς ἄνδρας ἀκροβυστίαν ἔχοντας καὶ συνέφαγες αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
controles.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Tu entraste na casa de homens incircuncisos, e comeste com eles.

versos.grego: ἀρξάμενος δὲ Πέτρος ἐξετίθετο αὐτοῖς καθεξῆς λέγων

controles.web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
controles.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
controles.livre: Mas Pedro começou a lhes explicar tudo em ordem, dizendo:

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν πόλει Ἰόππῃ προσευχόμενος, καὶ εἶδον ἐν ἐκστάσει ὅραμα, καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιεμένην ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ἄχρι ἐμοῦ·

controles.web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
controles.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
controles.livre: Eu estava orando na cidade de Jope, e vi em êxtase uma visão: um certo objeto que descia como um grande lençol, pelas quatro pontas abaixado desde o céu, e vinha até mim.

versos.grego: εἰς ἣν ἀτενίσας κατενόουν, καὶ εἶδον τὰ τετράποδα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ θηρία καὶ τὰ ἑρπετὰ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

controles.web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
controles.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
controles.livre: No qual, olhando eu com atenção, considerei e vi quatro quadrúpedes da terra, e animais selvagens, e répteis, e aves do céu.

versos.grego: ἤκουσα δὲ καὶ φωνῆς λεγούσης μοι Ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

controles.web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
controles.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
controles.livre: E eu ouvi uma voz que me dizia: Levanta-te Pedro, mata e come.

versos.grego: εἶπον δέ Μηδαμῶς, Κύριε, ὅτι κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον οὐδέποτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου.

controles.web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
controles.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
controles.livre: Mas eu disse: De maneira nenhuma, Senhor; porque nunca comi coisa alguma ordinária, nem coisa imunda entrou em minha boca.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ ἐκ δευτέρου φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ Ἃ ὁ Θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

controles.web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
controles.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
controles.livre: E a voz me respondeu do céu pela segunda vez: O que Deus purificou, não o faças tu como ordinário.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ ἀνεσπάσθη πάλιν ἅπαντα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

controles.web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
controles.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
controles.livre: E isto aconteceu por três vezes; e voltou-se tudo a recolher acima ao céu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξαυτῆς τρεῖς ἄνδρες ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν ᾗ ἦμεν, ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Καισαρίας πρός με.

controles.web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
controles.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cesarea unto me.
controles.livre: E eis que logo três homens, enviados a mim de Cesareia, pararam junto à casa onde eu estava.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ τὸ Πνεῦμά μοι συνελθεῖν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρίναντα. ἦλθον δὲ σὺν ἐμοὶ καὶ οἱ ἓξ ἀδελφοὶ οὗτοι, καὶ εἰσήλθομεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀνδρός.

controles.web: The Spirit told me to go with them, without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
controles.kjv: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
controles.livre: E o Espírito me disse que eu fosse com eles, sem duvidar; e também estes seis irmãos foram comigo, e entramos na casa daquele homem.

versos.grego: ἀπήγγειλεν δὲ ἡμῖν πῶς εἶδεν τὸν ἄγγελον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ σταθέντα καὶ εἰπόντα· Ἀπόστειλον εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνα τὸν ἐπικαλούμενον Πέτρον,

controles.web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is called Peter,
controles.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
controles.livre: E ele nos contou como tinha visto um anjo estar em sua casa, e tinha lhe dito: Envia alguns homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro;

versos.grego: ὃς λαλήσει ῥήματα πρὸς σὲ ἐν οἷς σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκός σου.

controles.web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
controles.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
controles.livre: O qual te falará palavras, em que tu sejas salvo, e também toda a tua casa.

versos.grego: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἄρξασθαί με λαλεῖν ἐπέπεσεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ὥσπερ καὶ ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ἐν ἀρχῇ.

controles.web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
controles.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
controles.livre: E quando comecei a falar, caiu o Espírito Santo sobre eles, assim como também no princípio tinha caído sobre nós.

versos.grego: ἐμνήσθην δὲ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ Κυρίου, ὡς ἔλεγεν Ἰωάνης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι, ὑμεῖς δὲ βαπτισθήσεσθε ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
controles.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: E eu me lembrei da palavra do Senhor, como ele tinha dito: Verdadeiramente João batizou com água, mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν τὴν ἴσην δωρεὰν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς ὡς καὶ ἡμῖν, πιστεύσασιν ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ἐγὼ τίς ἤμην δυνατὸς κωλῦσαι τὸν Θεόν;

controles.web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
controles.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
controles.livre: Portanto, se Deus deu a eles igual dom, assim como também a nós, que temos crido no Senhor Jesus Cristo; quem era eu, pois, para que pudesse proibir a Deus?

versos.grego: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ταῦτα ἡσύχασαν, καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν Θεὸν λέγοντες Ἄρα καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὁ Θεὸς τὴν μετάνοιαν εἰς ζωὴν ἔδωκεν.

controles.web: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
controles.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
controles.livre: E ao ouvirem estas coisas, se acalmaram, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: Portanto também aos gentios Deus deu arrependimento para a vida.

versos.grego: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διασπαρέντες ἀπὸ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς γενομένης ἐπὶ Στεφάνῳ διῆλθον ἕως Φοινίκης καὶ Κύπρου καὶ Ἀντιοχείας, μηδενὶ λαλοῦντες τὸν λόγον εἰ μὴ μόνον Ἰουδαίοις.

controles.web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
controles.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
controles.livre: E os que foram dispersos por causa da perseguição que aconteceu por causa de Estêvão, passaram até a Fenícia, e Chipre, e Antioquia; não falando a ninguém a palavra, a não ser somente aos judeus.

versos.grego: Ἦσαν δέ τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρες Κύπριοι καὶ Κυρηναῖοι, οἵτινες ἐλθόντες εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν ἐλάλουν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς Ἕλληνας, εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
controles.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: E havia deles alguns homens cipriotas e cirenenses, os quais ao entrarem em Antioquia, falaram aos gregos, anunciando o Evangelho do Senhor Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν χεὶρ Κυρίου μετ’ αὐτῶν, πολύς τε ἀριθμὸς ὁ πιστεύσας ἐπέστρεψεν ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον.

controles.web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
controles.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E a mão do Senhor era com eles, e um grande número creu, e se converteu ao Senhor.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσθη δὲ ὁ λόγος εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς οὔσης ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ περὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν Βαρνάβαν ἕως Ἀντιοχείας·

controles.web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
controles.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
controles.livre: E esta notícia sobre eles chegou aos ouvidos da igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e enviaram a Barnabé, para ir até Antioquia.

versos.grego: ὃς παραγενόμενος καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν χάριν τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐχάρη, καὶ παρεκάλει πάντας τῇ προθέσει τῆς καρδίας προσμένειν τῷ Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
controles.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
controles.livre: O qual, ao chegar lá ,e tendo visto a graça de Deus, alegrou-se; e exortou a todos, para que com o propósito do coração permanecessem no Senhor.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἦν ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ πίστεως. καὶ προσετέθη ὄχλος ἱκανὸς τῷ Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
controles.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Porque ele era um bom homem, e cheio do Espírito Santo, e de fé; e uma grande multidão foi acrescentada ao Senhor.

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ εἰς Ταρσὸν ἀναζητῆσαι Σαῦλον,

controles.web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
controles.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
controles.livre: E Barnabé foi para Tarso, para buscar a Saulo; e achando-o, trouxe-o a Antioquia.

versos.grego: καὶ εὑρὼν ἤγαγεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν. ἐγένετο δὲ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνιαυτὸν ὅλον συναχθῆναι ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ διδάξαι ὄχλον ἱκανόν, χρηματίσαι τε πρώτως ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ τοὺς μαθητὰς Χριστιανούς.

controles.web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
controles.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que, durante um ano completo eles se congregaram naquela igreja, e ensinavam a uma grande multidão; e em Antioquia os discípulos foram chamados pela primeira vez de cristãos.

versos.grego: Ἐν ταύταις δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις κατῆλθον ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων προφῆται εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν·

controles.web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
controles.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
controles.livre: E naqueles dias desceram de Jerusalém alguns profetas a Antioquia.

versos.grego: ἀναστὰς δὲ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ὀνόματι Ἅγαβος ἐσήμαινεν διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος λιμὸν μεγάλην μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν οἰκουμένην· ἥτις ἐγένετο ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου.

controles.web: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
controles.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cesar.
controles.livre: E levantando-se um deles, por nome Ágabo, declarou pelo Espírito, que estava para haver uma grande fome em todo o mundo; que veio a acontecer no tempo de Cláudio César.

versos.grego: τῶν δὲ μαθητῶν καθὼς εὐπορεῖτό τις, ὥρισαν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν εἰς διακονίαν πέμψαι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἀδελφοῖς·

controles.web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
controles.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judea:
controles.livre: E os discípulos determinaram de cada um, conforme o que pudesse, mandar algum socorro para serviço dos irmãos que habitavam na Judeia.

versos.grego: ὃ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀποστείλαντες πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους διὰ χειρὸς Βαρνάβα καὶ Σαύλου.

controles.web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
controles.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
controles.livre: O que também fizeram, enviando -o aos anciãos  pela mão de Barnabé e de Saulo.
